run_cifar10_federated_learning: run the CIFAR10 federated learning example with python3 cifar10_example.py --config-file configs/cifar10_config.json
build_data_provider: build a DataProvider for CIFAR10 using SequentialSharder with a specified local batch size and examples per user
train_federated_model: train a SimpleConvNet model using FLSim trainer with a DataProvider and MetricsReporter for CIFAR10 classification
test_federated_model: test the trained federated learning model using the trainer test method with a DataProvider and STDOUT metrics reporter
create_fl_model: create an FLModel wrapping a SimpleConvNet with CUDA support for federated learning on CIFAR10 data
